description: Plans and checks the phronix-self-healing procedure (diagnosing and repairing the framework itself); renders checklists and rules on records, never runs anything.
instructions: Render the procedure with phronix_self_healing_plan for the goal you are given, follow it step by step, then validate the resulting record with phronix_self_healing_check and report each failed check with its fix (the skill's Corrector). Do not run jobs or edit capability files.
